messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — opened a small PR to tighten compliance wording around audit logs + swap in the new SDK retention snippet. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (preview should be up)
Jordan: thanks — saw the diff. one legal nit: avoid wording that promises deletion by a strict date. better to say 'retained in accordance with our retention policy' and link the policy.
Sam: noted. also the old SDK snippet used `retention_days` which we deprecated. new param is `retention_policy` (string). will add both py + curl examples.
Priya: can we call out redaction behavior too? e.g., that PII-level redaction happens before export and that customers can request exports with redaction applied. also add cross-ref to the SOC2 FAQ.
Maya: good catches. I'll rephrase to Jordan's suggested line and add a short note about redaction per Priya. putting the SOC2 FAQ link in next commit.
Sam: pushing the snippet I plan to use — please review:

```
# Python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = c.audit.export(tenant_id="acct-xxx", retention_policy="audit:30d", redacted=True)
print(resp.url)
```

curl example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acct-xxx","retention_policy":"audit:30d","redacted":true}'
```
Jordan: looks fine. tiny wording tweak: change `retained in accordance with our retention policy` -> `retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law` (keeps legal flexibility).
Maya: done. also added: "Customers can request redacted exports; sensitive tokens and keys are removed as part of the export pipeline." — Priya, ok that level of detail?
Priya: yep that's perfect. please don't include any internal implementation details though (no mention of specific keys or S3 paths).
Maya: got it. removed impl details. updated changelog entry and added a checkbox to the PR checklist for an SDK snippet smoke test.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/482/compliance-wording — preview expires in 7 days. :rocket:
Sam: quick question — do we need a migration note for customers still using `retention_days` in older SDKs?
Maya: good call. added a short migration section with a one-liner and a code diff example. will request reviews from @Jordan and @Priya before merging.
Jordan: approving once the wording and migration note are in. +1 from legal pending final pass. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks all — will merge after the final reviews. closing out follow-ups in the PR comments.
